description: A contemporary quilt coverlet set with everything you need to give your bedroom a bold, fresh look. The quilt features a patchwork Bohemian paisley print on the face with an embossed solid color design on the reverse. Design coordinated reversible pillow shams and a Boho-inspired embroidered decorative pillow are included to complete the look. Specifications: Size: King Color Scheme: Blue, Grey, White Piece Count: 4 Set Includes: 1pc Reversible Quilt (104” x 90”) 2pc Reversible Pillow Shams (20” x 36” + 2”) 1pc Embroidered Boho-Inspired Decorative Pillow (12” x 18”) Materials: Luxuriously brushed microfiber fabric, hypoallergenic synthetic down alternative filling Fabric and Design: Soft brushed microfiber cotton-feel material Fashion forward patchwork Bohemian paisley print design on the face with an embossed solid color backing Features: Luxuriously soft feel for a great night sleep with less tossing and turning Hypoallergenic alternative down filling is perfect for those allergic to traditional down materials Just the right fill to keep you comfortable when the weather gets warmer Built to last with premium fabrics and expert stitching Care Instructions Dry clean preferred. Machine washable, use front loader machine (or top loader without agitator) to avoid tearing, use cold water on gentle cycle, tumble dry low * Add 2 tennis balls to the dryer to speed up drying and add fluffiness The digital images we display have the most accurate color possible.
